wealthy.en: He grew up in a comfortable and wealthy family home surrounded by books and learning.
wealthy.zh: 他在一个舒适且富裕的家庭环境中长大，四周环绕着书籍和知识。

wealthy.en: People in Britain were becoming wealthier and even more urban than they had been before.
wealthy.zh: 英国人变得比以前更富裕，城市化程度也更高了。

wealthy.en: Their bright colors and unusual patterns made them extremely popular among wealthy people.
wealthy.zh: 它们鲜艳的色彩和不寻常的花纹使它们在富人阶层中极为受欢迎。

wealthy.en: Some countries and regions have become wealthier and more connected through EU membership.
wealthy.zh: 一些国家和地区通过欧盟成员国身份变得更加富裕、联系更加紧密。

wealthy.en: These moves were often connected to work, as he relied on wealthy patrons to support him.
wealthy.zh: 这些搬迁通常与工作有关，因为他依赖富有的赞助人来养活自己。

weigh.en: These are giant sculptures weighing up to 50 tons and possibly represent their rulers.
weigh.zh: 这些巨大的雕塑重达50吨，可能代表了他们的统治者。

weigh.en: Some Moai weigh more than 70 tons. One theory suggests that they were laid flat and dragged on wooden sleds.
weigh.zh: 有些 Moai 的重量超过70吨。有一种理论认为，它们是被放倒并用木质雪橇拖拽的。

weigh.en: The record for the world's largest packet of crisps was recently broken in Saudi Arabia, but how much did the packet weigh?
weigh.zh: 世界上最大包薯片的纪录最近在沙特阿拉伯被打破了，但这包薯片有多重呢？

weigh.en: Why not have a judge decide every case? After all, they are a professional, trained in the law, experienced in weighing evidence.
weigh.zh: 为什么不干脆让法官来裁决每一个案子？毕竟他们是专业人士，受过法律训练，也有权衡证据的丰富经验。

weigh.en: It’s not clear exactly what happened, and there are varying accounts, but most reports suggest that the police knocked over his fruit cart and took his weighing scales.
weigh.zh: 目前还不清楚具体发生了什么，说法也各有不同，但大多数报道表明，警察推翻了他的水果推车并拿走了他的秤。

weaken.en: The Remain Campaign warned that leaving would damage the economy and weaken Britain’s global influence.
weaken.zh: “留欧派”阵营则警告称，离开将损害经济并削弱英国的全球影响力。

weaken.en: The centuries of attacks from various different empires and armies significantly weakened Constantinople.
weaken.zh: 来自各个不同帝国和军队的数百年攻击大大削弱了君士坦丁堡。

weaken.en: The bleeding, the purging, the blistering, these would have weakened him physically.
weaken.zh: 放血、泻药、起泡剂，这些都会在肉体上削弱他。

weaken.en: Plus, his legendary resistance to tropical disease seemed to be weakening.
weaken.zh: 此外，他那对热带疾病的传奇抵抗力似乎也在减弱。

weaken.en: Firstly, as is often the case with great empires, corruption and mismanagement had weakened the empire from within.
weaken.zh: 首先，正如伟大帝国常有的那样，腐败和管理不善从内部削弱了帝国。

weapon.en: Sharks aren't the only migratory animal that acts as a secret weapon against climate change.
weapon.zh: 鲨鱼并不是唯一能充当对抗气候变化'秘密武器'的迁徙动物。

weapon.en: They couldn’t move. They couldn’t fight; they were too packed together to lift their weapons.
weapon.zh: 他们动弹不得。他们甚至无法战斗，因为挤得太紧连武器都举不起来。

weapon.en: Sophie says that many animals that migrate, like sharks, are a secret weapon against climate change.
weapon.zh: Sophie 说，像鲨鱼这样的许多迁徙动物，都是对抗气候变化的'秘密武器'(secret weapon)。

weapon.en: With industrialisation, urbanisation, and modern weapons, humans relied less on dogs for survival.
weapon.zh: 随着工业化、城市化以及现代武器的出现，人类对狗在生存方面的依赖减少了。

weapon.en: He hadn’t forced anyone to buy or sell drugs, weapons, or anything.
weapon.zh: 他没有强迫任何人购买或出售毒品、武器或任何东西。

weak.en: These stereotypes suggest that poverty is the result of bad choices or weak character.
weak.zh: 这些刻板印象暗示贫困是不良选择或性格薄弱的结果。

weak.en: Another factor is weak institutions. Institutions are organizations and systems in a country.
weak.zh: 另一个因素是体制薄弱。体制是一个国家中的组织和系统。

weak.en: The weaker your language skills are the less productive you are on average to the economy.
weak.zh: 你的语言技能越弱，你对经济的平均产出效率就越低。

weak.en: By the late 1980s, communist governments across Eastern Europe were becoming weaker.
weak.zh: 到了 20 世纪 80 年代末，东欧各国的共产主义政府日渐式微。

weak.en: It also occurs in places where the systems that are supposed to stop corruption are weak.
weak.zh: 它也发生在那些本应用来阻止腐败的体制十分薄弱的地方。

weekly.en: Sherlock Holmes’s original stories were published weekly or monthly, I think, in newspapers and magazines.
weekly.zh: 我想Sherlock Holmes最初的故事就是每周或每月在报纸和杂志上发表的。

weekly.en: You know, in fact, John and I joke now, but now he gets to do it weekly.
weekly.zh: 你知道，事实上，Jon和我现在开玩笑，但他现在每周做一次。

weekly.en: The second big change was a magazine. In July 1841, two journalists in London started a new weekly satirical publication.
weekly.zh: 第二个巨大的改变是一本杂志。1841 年 7 月，伦敦的两位记者创办了一份新的每周讽刺刊物。

weekly.en: Crisps, confectionery and chocolate, or savoury snacks and biscuits." And the answer was… b) confectionery and chocolate, which 45% of Britons indulge in weekly, according to that survey.
weekly.zh: 薯片、糖果和巧克力，还是咸味小吃和饼干。”答案是……b) 糖果和巧克力，根据该调查，45% 的英国人每周都会纵情享用它们。

weekly.en: But a weekly vocabulary quiz at the end of your school English class is very different to an IELTS exam, and in fact, these exams have very different goals.
weekly.zh: 但学校英语课结束时的每周词汇小测验与雅思考试截然不同，事实上，这些考试的目标大相径庭。

wealth.en: To spend wealth? Yeah, yeah. How you spend this time creating this wealth, accumulating.
wealth.zh: 花钱？是的，是的。你花时间创造这些财富，积累财富。

wealth.en: To spend wealth? Yeah, yeah. How you spend this time creating this wealth, accumulating.
wealth.zh: 花钱？是的，是的。你花时间创造这些财富，积累财富。

wealth.en: And lots of wealth came into the city. There was silver from Mexican mines.
wealth.zh: 大量的财富涌入这座城市。有来自墨西哥矿山的白银。

wealth.en: The DRC’s extraordinary mineral wealth, has made its problems far more difficult to solve.
wealth.zh: 刚果（金）非凡的矿产财富使其问题变得更加难以解决。

wealth.en: Wealth in the terms of buying numerous properties or having a massive pension fund.
wealth.zh: 这里所说的财富是指购买多处房产或拥有庞大的养老金基金。

weekday.en: We have a new episode every single weekday and we talk about the news, trending topics.
weekday.zh: 我们每个工作日都有一期新节目，讨论新闻和热门话题。

welfare.en: Oil paid for everything—the palaces, the welfare state, the military, the sprawling bureaucracy.
welfare.zh: 石油支付了一切费用——宫殿、福利国家、军队、庞大的官僚机构。

welfare.en: This is often for health, animal welfare or environmental reasons.
welfare.zh: 这通常是为了健康、动物福利或环保的原因。

welfare.en: It was not until 1948, with the National Assistance Act and the formal creation of the welfare state, that the Poor Law, and the workhouse, were finally abolished.
welfare.zh: 直到 1948 年，随着《国民援助法》的颁布和福利国家的正式建立，《济贫法》和济贫院才终于被废除。

welfare.en: We'll learn why they were created, what life was really like inside them, hear some shocking stories, and learn how they were replaced by the welfare state we have today.
welfare.zh: 我们将了解它们建立的原因、里面的真实生活是什么样的、听一些令人震惊的故事，并了解它们后来是如何被我们今天的福利国家制度所取代的。

welfare.en: But there are also those on the right who support it as a way of reducing the need for government welfare, arguing that if people are paid more, they rely less on the state.
welfare.zh: 但右翼中也有人支持它，认为这可以减少对政府福利的需求，理由是如果人们拿到的报酬更多，他们对国家的依赖就会减少。

weakness.en: Actually, Leonardo’s curiosity was probably one of his weaknesses, as well as one of his strengths.
weakness.zh: 事实上，列奥纳多的好奇心可能既是他的优势，也是他的弱点之一。

weakness.en: It can hide your weaknesses, because switching helps you avoid challenging areas instead of learning them.
weakness.zh: 它能掩盖你的弱点，因为切换能帮你避开具有挑战性的领域，而不是去攻克它们。

weakness.en: And where the weaknesses in the old system lay.
weakness.zh: 以及旧体制的弱点在哪里。

weakness.en: You say thinking about yourself is the source of all unhappiness, but presumably you need to work on yourself and your weaknesses as well.
weakness.zh: 你说思考自己是所有不快乐的源头，但大概你也需要努力改善自己和你的弱点。

weakness.en: This was really the first time many Western countries saw how deeply they depended on oil and how quickly that reliance could become a weakness.
weakness.zh: 这实际上是许多西方国家第一次看到它们对石油的依赖有多深，以及这种依赖会以多快的速度变成一种软肋。

westward.en: Their leader, a man named Laurent-Désiré Kabila, promised an end to dictatorship, and as his forces advanced westward, city after city fell without a fight.
westward.zh: 他们的领袖洛朗-德西雷·卡比拉（Laurent-Désiré Kabila）承诺结束独裁统治，随着他的部队向西推进，一座又一座城市不战而降。

westward.en: This was the period when the United States was expanding westward at a ferocious pace, pushing into territories that had been home to Native American peoples for centuries, and absorbing land that had until recently belonged to Mexico.
westward.zh: 在这段时期，美国以极快的速度向西扩张，深入几个世纪以来一直是美洲原住民家园的土地，并吞并了不久前还属于墨西哥的领土。

weep.en: "I have made the worst mistake of my life," the young man said, almost weeping.
weep.zh: "我犯下了此生最严重的错误，"这个年轻人几乎带着哭腔说道。

weep.en: It's another part of all of this. Do I understand that in certain cultures, weeping openly is perfectly acceptable, and others, a more stoic attitude is expected, or that expressing great joy at one's accomplishment might be perfectly acceptable in America, but a little embarrassing in a place like Japan.
weep.zh: 这也是其中很重要的一部分。我是否理解，在某些文化中，公开哭泣是完全可以接受的，而在另一些文化中，人们期待的是更为克制的态度；又或者，在美国，对自己的成就表现出极大的喜悦可能完全没问题，但在日本这样的地方，可能就会显得有点尴尬。

wedding.en: I'm not expected to go to birthdays. I'm not expected to go to weddings.
wedding.zh: 没人指望我去参加生日派对。没人指望我去参加婚礼。

wedding.en: How many times does somebody say, yeah, of course, I'd love to come to the wedding.
wedding.zh: 有多少次，有人说：“好啊，我当然很乐意去参加婚礼。”

wedding.en: I would come to your wedding if I did not have work.
wedding.zh: 如果我没有工作，我会参加你的婚礼。

wedding.en: In the case of today’s protagonist, at the age of 25, his favourite drink–and his only contribution to his wedding banquet –was a single crate of beer, but at 45, his tastes had evolved.
wedding.zh: 对于今天的主人公来说，在25岁时，他最喜欢的饮料——也是他为婚宴准备的唯一贡品——只是一箱啤酒，但到了45岁，他的品味已经升级了。

wedding.en: That’s why similar patterns started to appear in very different places; a fireman in Paris was now no longer bidding for a property against the local greengrocer, schoolteacher, and wedding photographer, but against sophisticated international investors.
wedding.zh: 这就是为什么非常不同的地方开始出现类似的模式；巴黎的一名消防员现在不再是与当地的蔬菜商、学校老师和婚礼摄影师竞拍房产，而是与成熟的国际投资者竞争。

web.en: You start to see what a crazy web of confusing interconnections this whole process is.
web.zh: 你开始发现，整个过程交织成了一张多么疯狂、令人头晕目眩的复杂网络。

web.en: And then you have the next web of comfort because it's way better than you were before.
web.zh: 然后你会进入下一个舒适区，因为这比你之前的状况好太多了。

web.en: Mobutu ruled through a complex web of patronage, of dispersing power, favours and money to his family, friends and allies.
web.zh: 蒙博托通过复杂的裙带关系网络进行统治，将权力、恩惠和金钱分发给他的家人、朋友和盟友。

web.en: So, even before we get to the question of AI, every time you open a web page, watch a YouTube video, and yes, even listen to a podcast, a little bit of energy is being used somewhere in the world to make that happen.
web.zh: 因此，甚至在我们讨论人工智能问题之前，每当你打开一个网页、观看一个 YouTube 视频，甚至是听播客时，世界上的某个地方都在消耗一点点能量来让这一切发生。

web.en: The happier you are, the more you can sustain doing something The more likely you're going to do something that will in turn make you even happier And you'll continue to do it and you'll outwork everybody else The more free you are, the better you can allocate your time And the less you're caught up in a web of obligations and commitments And the more you can focus on the task at hand This is related to another insight of yours the less you want something, the less you're thinking about it, the less you're obsessing over it, the more you're going to do it in a natural way.
web.zh: 你越快乐，你就越能持续地做某事。你越有可能做一些反过来让你更快乐的事情。你会继续做下去，你会比任何人都努力。你越自由，你就越能分配你的时间。你越少陷入义务和承诺的网中，你就越能专注于手头的任务。这与你的另一个见解有关：你越不想要某样东西，你对它的想法就越少，你对它的执念就越少，你就越会以自然的方式去做它。

weary.en: Not everyone bought it. To some, especially the urban middle class and Coptic Christians, it smelled like a power grab dressed up as reform; to others, people who had grown weary of corruption and poverty, it offered hope of a new dawn.
weary.zh: 并非所有人都买账。对一些人来说，尤其是城市中产阶级和科普特基督徒，这闻起来就像是一场伪装成改革的权力争夺；而对另一些人来说，那些对腐败和贫困感到厌倦的人，它提供了一个新黎明希望。

weary.en: Governments first started to get involved at the end of the 19th century, and in fact, the first countries to legislate minimum wage laws were in a part of the world you might not necessarily expect: not post-revolutionary France or English factory workers weary of working 12 hours a day, 7 days a week.
weary.zh: 政府在 19 世纪末开始介入，事实上，最早制定最低工资法的国家可能出乎你的意料：不是革命后的法国，也不是那些厌倦了每周 7 天、每天工作 12 小时的英国工厂工人。

weed.en: He's like somewhere deep inside me is this guy that just wants to smoke weed and lay in bed all day.
weed.zh: 他说，在我内心深处，有这样一个家伙，只想抽大麻，整天躺在床上。

weed.en: This matched other research that shows, for example, that farmers who are well-off tend to weed their fields more regularly than farmers who are poor.
weed.zh: 这与其他的研究所显示的相吻合，例如，手头宽裕的农民往往比贫穷的农民更经常地给田地除草。
